panels.title: Android APK downloads (time range)

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT s.ts, CASE WHEN a.kind = 'android-apk' THEN 'android' WHEN a.kind IN ('standalone-amd64','standalone-arm64','lite','lite-stalwart') THEN 'webmail' ELSE 'other' END AS product, s.download_count - lag(s.download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY s.repo_id, s.asset_id ORDER BY s.ts) AS delta FROM release_asset_snapshots s JOIN release_assets a USING (repo_id, asset_id)), c AS (SELECT ts, 'container' AS product, download_count - lag(download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY package ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM container_pull_snapshots), t AS (SELECT ts, 'ios' AS product, install_count - lag(install_count) OVER (PARTITION BY build_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM testflight_build_snapshots), d AS (SELECT ts, product, greatest(delta, 0) AS delta FROM (SELECT * FROM a UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t) u WHERE delta IS NOT NULL) SELECT coalesce(sum(delta), 0) AS value FROM d WHERE product = 'android' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Increase of the counters within the dashboard time range. History starts 2026-10-19 (first collector run).

panels.title: Downloads per day
panels.description: Daily increase of the download counters. Container pulls are on their own axis because they dwarf the rest.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT s.ts, CASE WHEN a.kind = 'android-apk' THEN 'android' WHEN a.kind IN ('standalone-amd64','standalone-arm64','lite','lite-stalwart') THEN 'webmail' ELSE 'other' END AS product, s.download_count - lag(s.download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY s.repo_id, s.asset_id ORDER BY s.ts) AS delta FROM release_asset_snapshots s JOIN release_assets a USING (repo_id, asset_id)), c AS (SELECT ts, 'container' AS product, download_count - lag(download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY package ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM container_pull_snapshots), t AS (SELECT ts, 'ios' AS product, install_count - lag(install_count) OVER (PARTITION BY build_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM testflight_build_snapshots), d AS (SELECT ts, product, greatest(delta, 0) AS delta FROM (SELECT * FROM a UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t) u WHERE delta IS NOT NULL) SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d', 0), coalesce(sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE product = 'android'), 0) AS "Android APK", coalesce(sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE product = 'ios'), 0) AS "iOS TestFlight", coalesce(sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE product = 'webmail'), 0) AS "Webmail", coalesce(sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE product = 'container'), 0) AS "Container" FROM d WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mobile: APK downloads per release (all time)
panels.description: Lifetime GitHub download count of each release's APK, newest release on the right.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag, downloads FROM (SELECT r.tag, r.published_at, sum(a.download_count) AS downloads FROM release_assets a JOIN releases r USING (repo_id, release_id) WHERE a.kind = 'android-apk' AND r.draft = false GROUP BY r.tag, r.published_at ORDER BY r.published_at DESC LIMIT 30) x ORDER BY published_at

panels.title: Webmail: downloads per release by variant (all time)
panels.description: Lifetime GitHub download count per release, split by asset variant. Checksum files are not counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tag, "Standalone amd64", "Standalone arm64", "Lite", "Lite (Stalwart)" FROM (SELECT r.tag, r.published_at, coalesce(sum(a.download_count) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'standalone-amd64'), 0) AS "Standalone amd64", coalesce(sum(a.download_count) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'standalone-arm64'), 0) AS "Standalone arm64", coalesce(sum(a.download_count) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'lite'), 0) AS "Lite", coalesce(sum(a.download_count) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = 'lite-stalwart'), 0) AS "Lite (Stalwart)" FROM release_assets a JOIN releases r USING (repo_id, release_id) WHERE a.kind IN ('standalone-amd64','standalone-arm64','lite','lite-stalwart') AND r.draft = false GROUP BY r.tag, r.published_at ORDER BY r.published_at DESC LIMIT 30) x ORDER BY published_at

WITH d AS (SELECT package, ts, download_count - lag(download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY package ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM container_pull_snapshots) SELECT replace(p.package, 'bulwarkmail/', 'ghcr.io/bulwarkmail/') AS image, p.download_count AS total_pulls, coalesce((SELECT sum(greatest(d.delta, 0)) FROM d WHERE d.package = p.package AND d.delta IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(d.ts)), 0) AS pulls_in_range, p.updated_at AS last_checked FROM container_packages p ORDER BY total_pulls DESC

panels.title: iOS TestFlight builds
panels.description: Per-build metrics from App Store Connect. Installs are lifetime per build.

targets.rawSql: SELECT version, build_number AS build, uploaded_at AS uploaded, install_count AS installs, session_count AS sessions, crash_count AS crashes, feedback_count AS feedback, expired FROM testflight_builds ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT CASE kind WHEN 'standalone-amd64' THEN 'Standalone amd64' WHEN 'standalone-arm64' THEN 'Standalone arm64' WHEN 'lite' THEN 'Lite' WHEN 'lite-stalwart' THEN 'Lite (Stalwart)' END AS variant, sum(download_count) AS downloads FROM release_assets WHERE kind IN ('standalone-amd64','standalone-arm64','lite','lite-stalwart') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Container pulls per day by image

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT package, ts, download_count - lag(download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY package ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM container_pull_snapshots) SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d', 0), replace(package, 'bulwarkmail/', '') AS metric, sum(greatest(delta, 0)) AS pulls FROM d WHERE delta IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mobile downloads per day (Android APK vs. iOS TestFlight)

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT s.ts, CASE WHEN a.kind = 'android-apk' THEN 'android' WHEN a.kind IN ('standalone-amd64','standalone-arm64','lite','lite-stalwart') THEN 'webmail' ELSE 'other' END AS product, s.download_count - lag(s.download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY s.repo_id, s.asset_id ORDER BY s.ts) AS delta FROM release_asset_snapshots s JOIN release_assets a USING (repo_id, asset_id)), c AS (SELECT ts, 'container' AS product, download_count - lag(download_count) OVER (PARTITION BY package ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM container_pull_snapshots), t AS (SELECT ts, 'ios' AS product, install_count - lag(install_count) OVER (PARTITION BY build_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM testflight_build_snapshots), d AS (SELECT ts, product, greatest(delta, 0) AS delta FROM (SELECT * FROM a UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c UNION ALL SELECT * FROM t) u WHERE delta IS NOT NULL) SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d', 0), coalesce(sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE product = 'android'), 0) AS "Android APK", coalesce(sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE product = 'ios'), 0) AS "iOS TestFlight" FROM d WHERE product IN ('android', 'ios') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent releases: downloads by asset
panels.description: Every non-checksum asset of the last 15 releases per repo with its lifetime download count.

targets.rawSql: WITH recent AS (SELECT repo_id, release_id, tag, published_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id ORDER BY published_at DESC) AS rn FROM releases WHERE draft = false AND published_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.repo_id AS repo, r.tag, r.published_at AS published, a.name AS asset, a.kind, a.download_count AS downloads, a.size_bytes AS size FROM release_assets a JOIN recent r USING (repo_id, release_id) WHERE r.rn <= 15 AND a.kind NOT IN ('checksum', 'mapping') ORDER BY r.published_at DESC, a.name
